_note: Single source of truth for the transcranial PBM power and thermal model constants (NP-PWRSRC-001 OI-PWRSRC-13, GitHub #440). Hand-authored: edit THIS file, never the generated C header. The TypeScript audits read it through scripts/pbm-model.ts; the hub firmware reads firmware/hub_control/include/np_pbm_model.generated.h, which `bun scripts/check-pbm-model.ts --write` emits from it. scripts/check-pbm-model.ts fails CI if the header and this file disagree, or if a consumer script re-declares a constant as a literal. Every value is PROVISIONAL or a PLACEHOLDER: none is measured, and none may be quoted as a derived figure (check-thermal-dose.ts header; OI-PWR-01 has not run).
_generator: hand-authored; emitted to C by scripts/check-pbm-model.ts --write
